subject: general
question: After the signing of which treaty did the European Community come to be known as the European Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Treaty of Maastricht, 1992**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Treaty of Maastricht was signed on **7 February 1992** and came into force on **1 November 1993**.
 
• It marked a significant step in European integration and established the **European Union (EU)**.
 
• The treaty introduced the **three-pillar structure** of the EU, which included the European Communities, Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP), and Justice and Home Affairs (JHA).
 
• The Maastricht Treaty also laid the foundation for the **creation of a single European currency, the euro**, and established criteria for member states to adopt the euro.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Treaty of Lisbon, 2007:**

 
 
• Signed on 13 December 2007 and entered into force on 1 December 2009.
 
• Aimed to enhance the efficiency and democratic legitimacy of the EU and to improve the coherence of its actions.
 
• Introduced a more powerful European Parliament and a long-term President of the European Council.
 
 
 
• **The Single European Act, 1986:**
 
 
• Signed on 17 February 1986 and came into force on 1 July 1987.
 
• Focused on creating a single European market by 1992, removing trade barriers, and increasing political cooperation among member states.
 
• Laid the groundwork for the subsequent Maastricht Treaty.
 
 
 
• **The Treaty of Amsterdam, 1997:**
 
 
• Signed on 2 October 1997 and entered into force on 1 May 1999.
 
• Amended the Maastricht Treaty and the Treaty of Rome.
 
• Focused on reforms to enhance the efficiency of the EU, including more power to the European Parliament and changes in immigration and asylum policies.
